# CLAWBACK — The Forced-Return Loss Calculator for Resellers

> CLAWBACK is a free, browser-based calculator and guide library for resellers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot and Vinted. It calculates the true financial loss of a forced return or refund: refund exposure + unrecovered seller fees + seller-paid return shipping + item value drop − recovered value − confirmed reimbursements. All math runs client-side; no signup, no stored data.

## Calculator
- [CLAWBACK Return Loss Calculator](https://www.gotclawback.com/): Six-platform forced-return loss calculator with itemized loss receipt, appeal letter, tax record and photo-evidence checklist.
- [Platform Rules Overview](https://www.gotclawback.com/platforms.html): Per-platform return and fee rule summaries for eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot and Vinted.
- [Reseller Guides Hub](https://www.gotclawback.com/guides.html): Index of all CLAWBACK guides, including the photo-evidence dispute method and tax documentation guide.

## eBay guides
- [Does eBay refund the per-order fee on a return?](https://www.gotclawback.com/ebay-per-order-fee-return.html): Why the $0.30/$0.40 per-order fee usually stays with eBay on item-problem returns while the final value fee can be credited.
- [Who pays return shipping on eBay "not as described"?](https://www.gotclawback.com/ebay-not-as-described-shipping.html): INAD return-shipping responsibility, label cost math and a worked receipt.
- [eBay Returns for Sellers: What They Really Cost](https://www.gotclawback.com/ebay-return-policy-sellers.html): Fee credits by return reason, the 50% deduction rule, stepped-in cases and the evidence sellers should keep.

## Poshmark guides
- [Poshmark Damaged Returns: What Sellers Lose](https://www.gotclawback.com/poshmark-damaged-return.html): The 72-hour Posh Protect window, documenting swapped or damaged returns, and value-drop loss math.
- [How Much Does Poshmark Take? Poshmark Fees Explained](https://www.gotclawback.com/poshmark-fees-explained.html): 20% / $2.95 seller fee, $6.49 buyer-paid shipping, 2026 overweight tiers and real payout math.

## Mercari guides
- [Mercari Returns Explained: 72-Hour Rule & Who Pays](https://www.gotclawback.com/mercari-returns-explained.html): Return eligibility, buyer/seller deadlines, damaged and swapped-return evidence, and seller-loss calculation.
- [Mercari returns over 50 lbs: who pays the label?](https://www.gotclawback.com/mercari-over-50-pounds.html): The 50-lb threshold, dimensional weight, and the 3-business-day seller label deadline.

## Depop guides
- [How Much Does Depop Take From a Sale?](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-fees-explained.html): 0% selling fee in US/UK/AU, processing rates, Boosting fees, and what reverses on refund.
- [Are Depop Fees Refunded When You Refund a Buyer?](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-fees-refunded.html): Which Depop Payments fees reverse automatically and which costs remain with the seller.
- [When Do You Get Paid on Depop?](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-payout-time.html): Payout release windows by country, pending/available balances and withdrawal timing.
- [Does Depop Pay on Weekends?](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-weekend-payout.html): How weekends, business days and bank holidays shift payout expectations, and when to investigate a late payment.
- [Depop Shipping Explained](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-shipping-explained.html): Depop Shipping vs seller-arranged labels, weight rules and protection deadlines.
- [Is Depop Safe for Sellers? Scams, Returns & Protection](https://www.gotclawback.com/depop-safe-for-sellers.html): Fake payment messages, phishing, out-of-app payments, address-change scams, the seller's evidence checklist, and Depop Protection eligibility for US sellers.

## Vinted guides
- [Vinted Returns for Sellers: What Can You Actually Lose?](https://www.gotclawback.com/vinted-returns-explained.html): No-selling-fee model vs real return exposure — return postage, damaged and wrong-item returns, SNAD, deadlines and loss math.

## Whatnot guides
- [Whatnot Returns for Sellers: Refunds, Billbacks & What You Actually Lose](https://www.gotclawback.com/whatnot-returns-explained.html): Seller Provided Support, billbacks, 10-business-day return window, 48-business-hour inspection, 14-day appeals and ledger-adjustment loss math.
